label: Text 1
transcript: "Both my parents grew up in different countries. Neither of them speaks the other's first language well. They communicate in English. I grew up with three languages, but only one of them — German — is the one I dream in."

label: Text 2
transcript: "My identity is not a single label. It is a list that changes every year. When I was eleven, I was mainly the football kid. Now I am the kid who reads instead. I haven't told my old team yet."
